coupons_kind_ck.name: coupons_kind_ck
coupons_kind_ck.value: ("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."value" > 0 and "coupons"."value" <= 100) or ("coupons"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."value" > 0 and "coupons"."currency" is not null)

files_mime_ck.name: files_mime_ck
files_mime_ck.value:
("files"."kind" = 'recording' and "files"."mime" in ('audio/mpeg','audio/mp4','audio/x-m4a') and "files"."size_bytes" <= 10485760)
       or ("files"."kind" <> 'recording' and "files"."mime" in ('application/pdf','image/jpeg','image/png') and "files"."size_bytes" <= 5242880)

memorized_ranges_source_ck.name: memorized_ranges_source_ck
memorized_ranges_source_ck.value: "memorized_ranges"."source" in ('placement', 'report') and ("memorized_ranges"."source" = 'placement' or "memorized_ranges"."segment_id" is not null)

payments_reason_ck.name: payments_reason_ck
payments_reason_ck.value: "payments"."status" not in ('rejected', 'needs_fix') or "payments"."reason" is not null

users_identifier_ck.name: users_identifier_ck
users_identifier_ck.value: "users"."phone" is not null or "users"."email" is not null or "users"."google_sub" is not null or "users"."student_login"
